mechanism: Per univariate channel, FFT finds dominant frequency; patch window ≈ series_len/freq with fixed token count and overlap stride so segments cover the series even as cycle length drifts; zero-pad unused weights in a max-size Flex Projection instead of Moore–Penrose resize; OpenCL FeedForwardAdaptConv emits frequency-adapted tokens for Transformer stacks.
data_needed: Multivariate HistoryBars×variables; main_freq buffer; max window_in weights; FFT + PeriodsFinding + AdaptiveConvolution kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Financial/economic periodic series; EURUSD M1 in conclusion tests (18686)
why_new_for_mis: Live dominant-cycle length per channel is a compact periodicity/regime sensor—MIS can track when market rhythm lengthens/shortens without fixed seasonal calendars.
quote: the number of tokens (patches) remains constant, while their length is adjusted to the current frequency and the overlap is regulated to ensure complete coverage of the time series being analyzed.

mechanism: After adaptive patches, RoPE rotates token pairs by precomputed sin/cos phase so Self-Attention compares relative phase, not absolute bar index; complex multi-head attention (CNeuronComplexMLMHAttentionOCL) keeps phase-consistent Q/K; Encoder also uses TimeMoE sparse experts + three parallel forecast horizons so latent absorbs short impulse and long trend jointly for Actor–Director–Critic.
data_needed: Even embedding dim; PositionEncoder pe matrix; Segments tokens; EmbeddingSize; 4-head×3-layer complex attention; EURUSD OHLC+BarDescr
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; offline ~15y history; online fine-tune 2024; test Jan–Mar 2025
why_new_for_mis: Phase-aware patch sequence sensor that encodes relative cycle position after frequency-adaptive tokenization—MIS latent for periodic structure and multi-horizon regime context.
quote: RoPE does not encode positions within the patch — after all, at this stage they have already been collapsed into a single representation. Instead, it embeds information about the patch's position within the overall sequence.

mechanism: Bucket historical bar returns by day-of-month (1–31), day-of-week (Mon–Sun), or hour (0–23); average return per bucket (optionally %); histogram + forecast line/points project next 1–2 periods via cyclic GetNextPeriod; text stats expose best/worst buckets.
data_needed: OHLC time series; BarsToAnalyze (default 1000); SeasonalityType enum; close-to-close returns
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF (examples: EURUSD daily; hourly gold); session-hour and month-end effects discussed
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable calendar-regime prior (hour/DOW/DOM expected return) MIS can use as a soft schedule feature or gate alongside neural sensors.
quote: Our indicator will analyze historical price data to identify the average return for days of the month (1st to 31st), days of the week (Monday to Sunday), or hours of the day (0 to 23).

mechanism: MQL5 service SocketConnect to localhost:9070 streams JSON ticks (pair,time,bid,ask) for all open charts; Python server rebroadcasts on 9071 to symbol-keyed clients—transport/integration only, no market-state sensing algorithm.

quote: For demo purpose, I am going to transport only tick data (bid, ask and time of tick data) to the python application through socket ports

mechanism: Channel-joint non-overlapping patches → KoopmanNet ψ MLP + eDMD local/global operator linearizes dynamics; residual Transformer emits control U; KalmanNet Forecast–Correction updates state ẑ and covariance P; VAE reparameterizes Z~N(Z′,P) and decoder emits μ,σ trajectories—point path plus confidence intervals.
data_needed: Multivariate X (N vars × T); patch length s; Koopman/Kalman trainable A,B,H,Q,R; ELBO+LRec losses
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Currency pairs, indices, commodities in theory; EURUSD H1 in conclusion (18807)
why_new_for_mis: Joint mean+covariance probabilistic sensor: MIS gets scenario cloud and live uncertainty width as volatility/risk regime, not a single point forecast.
quote: As a result, the K²VAE framework produces not just a price forecast, but two related estimates: the value itself and the degree of confidence in it.

mechanism: KoopmanNet (TimeMoE sparse local experts + global expert) predicts next state and reconstructs past trajectory; Self-Attention runs on reconstruction-error tensor (not raw X) to build control vector from last-token error in full residual history; KalmanNet tightens P when residuals small/stable and widens P on structural shifts; VAE samples multiple next-step scenarios from that distribution.
data_needed: CNeuronK2VAEEncoder; cKoopmanPred/Rest; cAuxiliaryNet attention; Joseph-form P update; NScenarios samples
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Financial TS under uncertainty; EURUSD H1 in series conclusion
why_new_for_mis: Self-diagnosis residual-attention as a change/confidence sensor—MIS can read when linear latent dynamics break (widening P / large U) as a regime-shift precursor.
quote: If the deviations are small and persistent, KalmanNet interprets this as high confidence and, accordingly, tightens the covariance distribution… if significant imbalance or structural shifts are observed in the errors, the model… expands the covariance matrix

mechanism: Full stack: adaptive period patches + RoPE + K2VAEEncoder scenario cloud → TimeMoEAttention aggregate → Actor cross-attends account state to latent scenario distribution; narrower concentrated distribution → more decisive sizing; stochastic VAE action head explores early then concentrates; dual offline/online train on EURUSD H1.
data_needed: defNeuronK2VAEEncoder scenarios/experts; AccountDescr; CrossDMHAttention; three forecast horizons; DiscFactor/CheckAction over full history
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; offline ~15y; online 2024; test Jan–Mar 2025 (PF≈1.06)
why_new_for_mis: Policy that treats encoder distribution width as an explicit uncertainty/regime input—MIS can expose ‘forecast confidence → exposure’ as a fused neural risk sensor.
quote: The more confident the Encoder is in its forecast (which is expressed as a narrower and more concentrated distribution), the smaller the spread of scenarios the Actor receives. In that case, it can act more decisively

mechanism: Interpolation Attention builds learnable variable-correlation matrix AIA from embeddings; for each missing variable i, SoftMax attention aggregates observed neighbors’ hidden states with LReLU-gated coefficients to reconstruct h_i end-to-end inside SRU cells—no separate impute-then-forecast stage; claimed robust even at ~90% missing variables.
data_needed: Masked multivariate tensor XM; EIA embeddings; W/A/GL OpenCL InterpositionAttention kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multivariate financial MTS (assets/volumes/sectors); EURUSD H1 in series conclusion
why_new_for_mis: Missingness-aware cross-sectional imputer is a liquidity/data-availability sensor—MIS can keep multi-asset graphs alive when feeds drop and treat reconstruction reliance as a sparse-data regime flag.
quote: GinAR is based on… Interpolation Attention (IA)… that infers missing variables by applying attention algorithms to the available data…. the model maintained high accuracy even when up to 90% of the variables were unavailable.

mechanism: CNeuronAGCN learns node embeddings En from IA-completed features, forms adaptive adjacency via SoftMax(En Enᵀ)+identity, mixes with optional predefined Apre (distance/Pearson); dual SwiGLU streams (adaptive + prior) sum into gated GinARCell with Forget/Reset AGCN gates—graph topology rewires each step as correlations shift.
data_needed: SecondInput predefined adj; cEa/cWx/cWe/cAadapt; GinARCell IA+AGCN+gates; units×dimension
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multivariate series as graph nodes; trading stack EURUSD H1 (18914)
why_new_for_mis: Online-learned inter-variable graph is a spatial-regime sensor—MIS can monitor which instruments currently couple/decouple without a frozen correlation matrix.
quote: Unlike most graph-based models, where the structure is fixed in advance, here it is formed during the training process…. The model independently determines which variables should be linked together

mechanism: CNeuronGinAR shares one learnable global dependency matrix across stacked GinARCells, concatenates all cell finals into MLP decoder; Encoder feeds Actor+Critic with hybrid offline RL (Critic reward) plus supervised near-perfect OraculAction from future path—multi-horizon forecasts train latent for both prediction and trade policy.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr; RSI/CCI/ATR/MACD; GinAR layer; Actor/Critic; OraculAction targets
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; offline 2024; online Strategy Tester; test Jan–Mar 2025 (~10× capital then decay)
why_new_for_mis: End-to-end missing-tolerant graph-recurrent market-state encoder with dual RL/oracle training—MIS reusable multivariate sequence sensor under incomplete feeds.
quote: we added a learnable matrix of predefined relationships… shared by all cells within a single GinAR block. This makes it possible to capture stable, recurring correlations between variables throughout the analysis

mechanism: CEnhancedRiskManager tracks daily/weekly/total drawdown vs mode limits (conservative 2/6/1%, moderate 5/10/2%, aggressive 10/20/3%); RISK_CALC_ADAPTIVE uses equity when open losers exist else balance; warn at 80/90% of daily limit, block/open-close at breach; persists state across terminal restarts.
data_needed: Account balance/equity; startingBalance; open positions; global variables per account
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AggressiveGridEA martingale grid tested ~9y (any symbol in EA); prop-style risk modes
why_new_for_mis: Account-path drawdown regime (adaptive equity vs balance, staged warnings) as a portfolio-risk sensor MIS can gate strategy aggressiveness independent of price features.
quote: Adaptive calculation… If there are open losing positions, the calculation is based on equity to take into account actual losses. If positions are profitable, or if there are no open trades, the system uses balance.

mechanism: SCNN hierarchically peels multivariate series: long-term mean/σ over window ∆ → seasonal dilated window (τ,m; optional FFT period) → short-term small-δ window → SoftMax co-evolving attention across series for synchronous shocks → residual Rn,t; LT/seasonal extrapolated by constancy/phase reuse, ST/co-evolve/residual by AR with adaptive two-branch params; PeriodNorm OpenCL implements window z-score core.
data_needed: Multivariate Z; windows ∆/τ/δ; dilation m; co-evolve SoftMax weights; PeriodNorm/PeriodNormGrad kernels
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: General financial MTS (prices, volumes, indicators); no live symbol backtest in this first part
why_new_for_mis: Interpretable multi-layer structural decomposition (trend/season/impulse/cross-sync/noise) gives MIS separable regime channels plus a co-movement shock sensor.
quote: The main idea behind SCNN is to strategically decompose data into several heterogeneous components: not only long-term trends and seasonal fluctuations, but also rapidly changing, volatile segments.
